subject: Discovery recap + one quick question on priority
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@brightline.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + one quick question on priority

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Brightline's ingestion pipeline and the latency targets you need for the recommendation endpoint. Quick recap from our side and a single question on next steps: 

What we covered:
- Current traffic profile: ~25 QPS at 95th percentile; batchable in short windows when latency allows.
- Primary constraint: sub-120ms 95th token latency for the live recommender; offline reranks can be slower.
- Data concerns: PII-sanitization pipeline in front of model; you asked about private deployment options for PHI workloads.

Suggested next steps (my proposal):
1) 15-min follow-up with your infra lead to confirm network topology and KMS approach (I can loop in our Private team).
2) A short eval: we run a 48-hour smoke test against a dev mirror (no PHI) to size batching/kv-cache impacts.

One quick question: where does this sit on your priority list for Q2? Is this something Brightline needs to lock in now (committed capacity) or are you in discovery-only mode? A short note on priority helps me recommend the right path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Attaching the short discovery deck I referenced.

If helpful, I can propose two time slots this week for the infra sync: Tue 3/16 10am PT or Wed 3/17 2pm PT. Do either work?

Thanks —

Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap + one quick question on priority (Brightline)

Monica — quick question and want your read before I loop in solutions.

Forwarding the thread below. TL;DR: Daniel at Brightline liked the high-level approach but has gone quiet after my recap and a gentle bump. They mentioned PHI concerns and an infra lead who would need to validate KMS/network.

Options I'm weighing:
- Wait one more week and then propose a 15-min intro call with our Private deployment PM (low effort, shows seriousness).
- Offer a scoped 48-hour non-PHI smoke test on hosted to show perf (lower barrier than Private).
- If this looks like low priority, mark as nurture and reduce cadence to monthly.

Do you have a preference for which path converts better in cases where PHI is mentioned but prospect hasn't committed? Any templates for offering a hosted smoke test without overpromising on PHI handling?

Thanks —
Ava
